description: This file is a shell script used for managing firmware download and update processes in an embedded device or gateway. It includes functions for checking firmware versions, selecting download methods (direct or codebig), scheduling updates, handling reboots, and interacting with device hardware and configurations to perform firmware upgrades reliably.

methods.name: getCurrentFw
methods.description: Retrieves the currently installed firmware version from version files.

methods.name: checkFirmwareUpgCriteria
methods.description: Determines if a firmware upgrade is needed by comparing current and available versions.

methods.name: fetchFirmwareDetail
methods.description: Parses the last saved firmware download response to extract firmware details.

methods.name: checkMaintenanceWindow
methods.description: Checks whether the current time falls within the scheduled maintenance window for firmware upgrades.

methods.name: removeLegacyResources
methods.description: Performs cleanup of old log files and resources.

methods.name: checkrfcstatus
methods.description: Checks and processes RFC configuration files that may affect upgrade behavior.

methods.name: getBuildType
methods.description: Determines the build type (DEV, VBN, PROD, GSLB) from version info.
